import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    w = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    possible = True
    while m > 0 and possible:
        rem = m % w
        if rem == 0 or rem == 1:
            m //= w
        else:
            if rem == w - 1:
                m += 1
            else:
                possible = False
    print("YES" if possible else "NO")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
